title: Intake result (rev 4; G5 Option 1: overall index + generic recommendation only)
description: Public result surface. Carries an overall index and one fixed generic recommendation. No system names, no system scores, no per-system selection result, no question-keyed answers. No route. No fee. Unanswered question => REJECT.

overall.description: G18: half_up(sum(15 answers, each 1-6)/90*100). Attainable range is exactly 17..100; values 0-16 are unreachable and rejected.

recommendation.const: Review the AP reconciliation workflow evidence with the council.

answers_commitment.description: Optional. Keyed (private key held on the control VM, never published). Not reversible to answers and carries no grouping information. Verifiable only by the key holder.

contains.const: System-specific results are suppressed in public, by design, to protect the private association.
